upstream_preservation.comparison: Remove the marked EvoInquiry hook before comparing all Codex skill bodies to the pinned baseline. Retained runtime files remain byte-identical; audited retirements and document/check adaptations are explicit.

focused_regressions.command: python -m pytest tests/test_auto_proceed_contract.py tests/test_plugin_manifest.py tests/test_codex_skill_mirror.py tests/test_evo_inquiry.py -q

publication_policy_regressions.scope: Retired material, missing exemplar, and exemplar absent from release tracked-file list

development_checks.behavior_exercises: Synthetic only; no randomized outcome comparison

CI_scope: The beta tag runs full Linux and macOS regression suites before publishing assets; actual Actions results are authoritative.
artifact_integrity: Git-tracked source archives are checked against the publication policy. SHA256SUMS and release-manifest.json identify archive digests, source commit, and skill inventory.
limits: Windows and credential-gated integration checks were not exercised by the local full suite.
Live providers, GPUs, image renderers, and complete research pipelines are not verified end to end.
Inherited workflows primarily target ML/AI and related engineering research; broad discipline coverage is untested.
No validation proves general scientific correctness or improved research outcomes.
Raw local session/validation records are excluded from public Git content.
